digest.component_or_area: review-bot test harness and lifespan management
propositions: Entering the review-bot ASGI lifespan in tests inherited the production 1200-second queue-drain default, causing tests to hang or run long background reconciler and janitor tasks.
The test harness must bind SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS to 1.0 seconds globally and stub the reconcile_loop and janitor by default, while allowing opt-in to the real production behavior via test markers.
Test-local SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS overrides must take precedence over the suite baseline to support isolated test control.
The production DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS value of 1200 and production lifespan behavior must remain unchanged.
Tests entering the review-bot lifespan without explicit per-test stubs must complete safely and promptly with bounded shutdown time.
